name: agentic-sdlc
description: Agentic Software Development Lifecycle — end-to-end AI-driven workflow from idea to platform-ready issues. Covers requirement grilling, PRD writing, project constitution (with DDD bounded-context mapping, tiered branch/promotion CI models, and scoped amendment of an existing constitution), feature decomposition, TDD test planning, UI design elicitation and mockup generation, issue structuring, PMS delivery, domain-parallel agentic implementation (Ralph), bug reporting, and brownfield repo agent-readiness triage (deterministic scoring across git/build/test/CI/deps/debt/structure signals, gated verdicts, and pilot-zone recommendations for portfolios of undocumented legacy repos).
